description.value: Norco North Shore is a dedicated Norco brand dealership and full-service repair centre located on Brooksbank Avenue in North Vancouver, one of BC's premier mountain biking destinations. The shop stocks an extensive range of Norco bikes spanning enduro, trail, cross-country, freeride, dirt jump, gravel, urban, youth, and VLT e-bike categories, alongside a comprehensive parts and accessories inventory. Their in-house service centre employs mechanics with broad experience across mountain, road, and city bikes, including full-suspension tuning and customization.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces, covered) at 47m; rack (4 spaces) at 81m; rack (6 spaces) at 83m. Total: 15 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, full-service Norco dealership with a dedicated service centre described as 'the premier destination in North Vancouver for bicycle maintenance, repair, set-up, and customization,' with mechanics experienced in mountain, road, and city bikes — supporting the required mechanical help criterion. No explicit mention of a floor pump for visiting cyclists, walk-in policy, same-day service, rentals, or most optional amenities is found, so those are left null per evidence rules. The business name on the website ('Norco North Shore') differs from the OSM record ('Norco Bicycles - North Shore'), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Norco Bicycles - North Shore' but the website consistently uses 'Norco North Shore' as the trade name.
OSM address lacks a street number (only 'Brooksbank Avenue' listed); full civic address could not be confirmed from website content.
Phone number could not be confirmed from the fetched website content — no phone number was visible in the scraped pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service Norco dealership and repair centre in North Vancouver with experienced mechanics — a clear asset for touring cyclists in a major BC mountain biking hub.
